verified_context: The painting was inspired by the view from the artist's room at Saint-Paul-de-Mausole in Saint-Rémy.
The village in the painting could not be seen from the artist's window.
imagined_context: The village streets, small rural figures, blue-hill flight route, church orbit and star-halo passage are invented for this film. They are not a documented 1889 route.
visual_anchors: low village and recognizable church steeple below a blue ridge
central cobalt spiral, white-yellow circular star halos and upper-right moon

keyframes.beat_zh: 低空村庄街道，建立飞行方向与时代氛围。
keyframes.camera_position: eye-level to low drone height over a narrow painted village lane
keyframes.camera_direction: forward toward a tiny distant church steeple and blue ridge
keyframes.camera_path_from_next_frame: reverse down from the hill and rooftops into this street
keyframes.transition_object_screen_position: near center, with blue hill small beyond roofs
keyframes.exit_state: beginning of a climb above roofs
end_frame_constraints: three to six tiny rural figures without readable faces
must_preserve: The Starry Night cobalt and warm yellow palette
same village, ridge and church geography
keyframes.image_prompt_en: An imagined late-19th-century village street inside the oil-painted world. Cobalt houses on both sides, warm yellow windows, three to six tiny people, no face closeups. Rooftops lead toward a tiny church and the same distant blue ridge. Wide horizontal painted composition.

keyframes.beat_zh: 第一镜蓝色山体遮挡后的自然出口。
keyframes.camera_position: very close to the near side of the blue mountain shoulder, just above village roofs
keyframes.camera_direction: along the hill toward the village on its far side
keyframes.camera_path_from_next_frame: reverse away from the church along the same blue hill until the hill obscures the view
keyframes.transition_object_screen_position: hill covers about 35%–55% of image, mostly right and center; village and church visible at left
keyframes.exit_state: hill starts to clear so the church is reachable
must_preserve: The Starry Night cobalt and warm yellow palette
same village, ridge and church geography
keyframes.image_prompt_en: Interface frame: the same blue hill is still a large foreground occluder, not a clean panorama. Its far side reveals only part of the painted village; the church steeple is recognizable and can be approached next.

keyframes.beat_zh: 从同侧抵达教堂尖塔近景，塔尖可与一颗星晕对齐。
keyframes.camera_position: close beside the church steeple on the same approach side as shot 2
keyframes.camera_direction: past the spire toward a white-yellow halo star above it
keyframes.camera_path_from_next_frame: reverse downward and backward from the selected star halo to the steeple side
keyframes.transition_object: steeple silhouette and selected star halo
keyframes.transition_object_screen_position: spire near center-right in strong foreground; chosen white-yellow halo visibly above spire tip
keyframes.entry_state: spire already close on same side as shot 2
keyframes.exit_state: clear upward path from tip into halo
must_preserve: The Starry Night cobalt and warm yellow palette
same village, ridge and church geography
keyframes.image_prompt_en: The painted church steeple is near the camera from the same side as the previous approach. Roofs and ridge remain behind it. One bright circular white-yellow star halo sits above its tip, ready for a short camera rise and alignment. It is a painted star, not a portal.

keyframes.beat_zh: 刚从同一星晕穿出，边缘仍受光晕遮挡。
keyframes.camera_position: a short retreat and slight lateral correction before the exact final painting view
keyframes.camera_direction: toward final composition: cypress left, village low, spiral center, moon upper right
keyframes.camera_path_from_next_frame: reverse forward into the same halo from the exact original painting viewpoint
keyframes.transition_object: same circular painted star halo as shot 3
keyframes.transition_object_screen_position: large white-yellow halo arc still occludes one frame edge; the rest reveals near-final layout
keyframes.entry_state: emerging from halo with shared curved edge
keyframes.exit_state: only a small retreat and lateral correction remain
end_frame_constraints: not a clean copy of the painting
all major landmarks in approximately correct screen regions
must_preserve: The Starry Night cobalt and warm yellow palette
same village, ridge and church geography
keyframes.image_prompt_en: Just beyond the selected painted star halo. Its large curved white-yellow brushstroke rim still occupies one frame edge. Beyond it, the original arrangement begins to resolve: left cypress, village and church low, blue ridge, central spiral, moon upper right. Keep a little camera distance for the last shot; do not output the exact painting yet.

shots.beat_zh: 街道低飞、抬升越屋顶、俯瞰村庄，主动冲向蓝色山肩。
shots.start_state: KF1: low street toward church and hill
shots.camera_path: 0–35% low forward street flight; 35–65% climb smoothly over roofs; 65–80% overview village; 80–100% approach blue mountain shoulder
shots.speed_profile: brisk then rising, slow near hill
shots.parallax: near walls move fastest, roofs slower, distant church and ridge slowest
shots.environment_motion: tiny people move subtly and warm windows glow within thick blue paint
shots.transition_approach: blue hill progressively covers most of view from the same side as KF2
shots.final_quarter_target_state: the same blue mountain shoulder occupies much of the last view, with village beginning to appear beyond it
shots.motion_prompt_en: One continuous drone-like subjective flight in thick cobalt and yellow oil paint. No cut, modern object, visible drone, readable text or photorealism.
shots.transition_zh: 蓝山肩近景遮挡，再从同一山肩另一侧显露。

shots.beat_zh: 沿山肩约 100～140 度弧线滑出，再俯瞰村庄并下降到尖塔。
shots.start_state: same blue shoulder still covers 35%–55%, village beginning to show
shots.camera_path: 0–20% slide out from hill; 20–65% travel a 100–140 degree arc along shoulder, not a 360 orbit; 65–100% lock church and descend on one side
shots.speed_profile: steady lateral arc then smooth descent and ease-in
shots.parallax: hill slides quickly against slower village and ridge; steeple grows continuously
shots.environment_motion: painted sky and village lights move subtly without geography changes
shots.transition_approach: approach the same side of the spire shown in KF3 and preserve its outline
shots.final_quarter_target_state: spire is large, close and on the same approach side, with roofs and ridge behind
shots.motion_prompt_en: Keep one uninterrupted camera move, stable steeple geometry and the original village layout. No architecture melting or teleportation.
shots.transition_zh: 尖塔轮廓匹配，保持同侧抵达。

shots.beat_zh: 围绕尖塔小弧线运动，沿塔尖对齐星晕并飞入。
shots.start_state: close to same side of steeple, roofs and ridge behind
shots.camera_path: 0–55% limited arc beside spire; 55–75% rise along tip and align to one painted star halo; 75–100% fly straight into that halo
shots.speed_profile: controlled orbit, short rise, steady entry
shots.parallax: spire shifts against slower roofs, village and ridge; star stays fixed in sky
shots.environment_motion: white-yellow circular brushstrokes shimmer like paint, not digital effects
shots.transition_approach: the chosen star halo fills frame; next shot exits through same curved edge
shots.final_quarter_target_state: painted halo dominates as a natural occluder and KF4 retains its rim
shots.motion_prompt_en: A single poetic camera move through the painting's own circular star brushstrokes. No science-fiction portal, cut, text or distorted church.
shots.transition_zh: 以原画星晕笔触遮挡并从同一笔触中穿出。

shots.beat_zh: 从星晕中飞出，建立原画空间关系，减速抵达原画。
shots.start_state: same oversized halo arc touches edge at opening
shots.camera_path: 0–20% emerge; 20–70% establish left cypress, low village and steeple, ridge, central spiral and upper-right moon; 70–100% slow retreat and tiny lateral correction
shots.speed_profile: moderate exit, progressively slower, nearly still at end
shots.parallax: near halo edge recedes fastest while cypress, village and sky settle
shots.environment_motion: painterly sky remains gently alive until the original painting freeze
shots.transition_approach: align with the canonical uploaded painting; exact original follows for 24 frames
shots.final_quarter_target_state: match the original viewpoint and stop without changing its landmarks
shots.motion_prompt_en: The painted world resolves into The Starry Night. Preserve every major original shape and finish on supplied last-frame painting. No extra object, text or cut.
shots.transition_zh: 细微后退横移，对齐同一原画后进入 24 帧静止。
